text: FABLE REVIEW SCHEDULED (risk 2 of 6). Why risky: this is the contract every other slice rests on, and two passes each found a door in it -- revision 1 discarded the bytes it hashed; revision 2 exposed a mutable Array with two aliasing routes. Review must attack: is copy-before-hash real, or does verify retain the store's reference? Does IArray actually close both routes? Can open reach bytes any way other than v.artifacts?
